parameters.description_en: The token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
